changes.from: Initial 45 days (Ord. 3063, term would have run through approximately 2026-05-02); extended 10 months and 15 days by Ord. 3065, adopted 2026-04-22. Under Gov. The exact date is not stated verbatim in the minutes reviewed and is calculated from the statutory ceiling, not quoted from a source.
